scope: Close the residual Java native level-mutation and group-level service frontier by classifying every setLevel, recalculateLevel, and getGroupObjectLevel reference while preserving NPC and later-content level data.

findings: Publish 14.1 player progression is skill-box and XP-pool based; scripts cannot force a player onto an NGE level axis.
The hidden player con value is recalculated from the readied weapon family's PRE-CU combat-difficulty skill modifier and is not progression authority.
Authored NPC levels and retained later-content encounter levels remain valid non-player compatibility data.

nativeScriptBridge.authority: Generated Java wrappers only; native CreatureObject distinguishes players from non-player creatures.

precuPlayerRefresh.authority: Login initialization refreshes the hidden PRE-CU weapon-skill con value and cannot grant level XP or level-derived Health.

retainedNonPlayerContent.authority: Authored NPC, pet, Beast, hologram, patrol, tutorial, and expansion encounter levels remain available only to non-player objects.

dormantCompatibility.authority: One unattached working diagnostic and one uncalled legacy AI damage helper retain link-compatible references without production authority.

buildEvidence.sourceAudit: passed; all 20 Java level-mutation/group-level service references classified with zero NGE player progression authority
buildEvidence.gameplayBuildReused: No gameplay source or data changed; the authenticated 5,717-source x64 deployment at the pinned dsrc/native revisions remains authoritative.
